The Smash Lineup

Five burgers.
Zero shortcuts.

Every signature burger starts the same way: two patties smashed hard on the flat-top until the edges go lacy and crisp, then stacked on a toasted brioche bun.

All signature smashes — $10 to $15
01

Classic Smash

The original — double-smashed patties and melted cheese on toasted brioche. The one that started it all in 2021.

$10–$15Double patty · Brioche
02

OG Deluxe

The deluxe build, Savannah style — the classic smash, loaded up the way regulars order it.

$10–$15Double patty · Brioche
03

Bacon Smash

Double smash patties finished with crispy bacon. Salty, smoky, gone in minutes.

$10–$15Double patty · Brioche
04

Triple Threat

Turned all the way up — the biggest attitude on the menu, built on the same double-patty smash.

$10–$15Double patty · Brioche
05

Caribbean Heat SmashBrings the heat

Island heat meets Savannah soul — the spicy one, for people who like their smash with a kick.

$10–$15Double patty · Brioche

The Savannah
Smash Wrap

All the smash, wrapped up and grilled. The Savannah Smash Wrap takes the truck's signature flavours off the bun and into a toasted wrap — same energy, new format.

Sides & Sips

Build the full tray

A smash burger travels with company. Round out the tray with loaded fries, wings your way, and a lemonade to wash it all down.

Loaded Fries

Golden fries buried under melted cheese and all the good stuff. Built for sharing — rarely shared.

Island style →

Caribbean Street Fries

The Caribbean side of the menu, in fry form. Street-style fries with island flavour — the perfect partner for the Caribbean Heat Smash.

Wings, Your Way

Pick your flavour — tap one to see it on your tray:

Fresh Lemonades

Ice-cold and fresh — the Savannah heat doesn't stand a chance. The only correct finish to a smash tray.

Smashed on the flat-top, to order

Every patty hits the hot griddle as a ball of beef and gets pressed thin — that's where the crispy edges and the big flavour come from.

Find the Truck

We're a truck.
Chasing us is half the fun.

  • No fixed address — we rollSmashed Savannah is a mobile food truck serving Savannah, GA and its events. Where we park is where dinner is.
  • Event-based hoursHours follow the truck's event schedule — check Instagram or call ahead to find out where we're serving next.
  • Follow the stops@smashedsavannah on Instagram — locations and event days land there first.
